**drawio-pro-skill v1.5.1 Changelog**

- Added modular reference and script files: diagram types, style presets, troubleshooting guide, Draw.io URL encoder, and PNG repair utility.
- Updated workflow to reference new bundled resources on demand.
- Changed update check: now notifies users about new versions instead of silently auto-updating; never mutates skill files without consent.
- Removed legacy and duplicate documentation (README.md, Chinese README, OpenAI config, HTML docs).
- Improved handling of style presets and error troubleshooting with structured reference files.

Harden Linux/headless export guidance (issue #9): snap warning, --no-sandbox argument-position fix, HOME/appData fallback, --disable-gpu for serverless GPU errors, tomkludy/drawio-renderer Docker as final fallback.

feat(#5): workflow honors user-specified output directory — export to any path the user mentions (e.g. ./artifacts/, docs/images/), mkdir -p handled automatically. Ideal for CI/CD artifact pipelines. fix(#4): browser fallback URL encoding — raw deflate (no zlib header) + standard base64 (atob rejects url-safe -/_). Verified via round-trip. docs: CI-style example in Commands; Clarify checklist gained 'Output location'. Full changelog: https://github.com/Agents365-ai/drawio-skill/releases/tag/v1.4.0

v1.3.0: Style Presets — learn/save/apply named styles from .drawio files or images; 3 built-ins (default, corporate, handdrawn); management ops (list, show, set default, delete, rename); Opencode platform support
Auto-update check (12h throttled) + Opencode support. See https://github.com/Agents365-ai/drawio-skill/releases/tag/v1.2.0
Landing page, fix ClawHub security flags: clarify vision requirement for self-check, client-side browser fallback, add homepage metadata

**drawio-pro-skill v1.1.0 Changelog**

- Expanded trigger keywords to include architecture diagrams, ER diagrams, UML (sequence/class), and neural network/model architectures.
- Improved usage guidance for when to engage the skill, with clearer examples.
- Added instructions for multi-line labels in Draw.io XML (use `
`).
- Included instructions for auto-launching the `.drawio` file in desktop app after export (macOS/Linux/Windows).
- Updated and consolidated documentation; removed redundant English README file.

Initial public release of drawio-skill.

- Generates .drawio XML files and exports diagrams to PNG, SVG, PDF, and JPG using local draw.io desktop app CLI.
- Proactively suggests diagrams for complex systems, multi-step processes, and architectural comparisons.
- Supports review loop: self-checks for common diagram issues, allows iterative user feedback and targeted edits.
- Guides installation and CLI usage for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
- Output files include both editable source (.drawio) and image exports, with proper file path reporting.
